intro.title: Design Auth Flow
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple authentication flow component that toggles between a login form and a welcome message. You will learn how to manage component state in React to control what the user sees based on their login status. The main technologies used are React functional components, TypeScript for type safety, and the useState hook for state management. By the end, you'll understand how to conditionally render UI elements to create a basic interactive user experience.
intro.usecase: Authentication flows are fundamental to nearly every modern web application that requires user accounts. You'll implement these patterns in e-commerce sites like Amazon during checkout, in banking apps like Chase for secure login, and in productivity tools like Notion for team workspace access. As a developer, you'll build these flows using protected routes, login forms, and session management to control access to dashboards, user profiles, and subscription features. Mastering auth flow design ensures you can create secure, professional applications that handle user identity and permissions correctly.
